newsitem.title: UK: UMECO to acquire Wellmar for 9.2 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UMECO to acquire Wellmar for 9.2 mln stg.

text.p: UMECO Plc said on Wednesday it would buy Wellmar Ltd for 9.2 million stg and has arranged a placing and open offer of 4.09 million new shares at 240 pence each to meet the costs.

Wellmar is the parent company of G.R.P. Material Supplies Ltd -- the independent distributor of polyester resin, glass fibre and complementary products to manufacturers of reinforced plastic products.
UMECO is a distributor of fasteners, seals, sealants and adhesives, and a manufacturer aircraft refuelling equipment and tube manipulator.
The placing and open offer of new shares is on a five for 14 basis.
UMECO said the acquisition demonstrated its commitment to investing in its core activities and is expected to enhance earnings.
The company also said in a statement that Brian McGowan and Clive Snowdon had been appointed chairman and chief executive respectively from April 28.
